Initialize a managed cloud k3s context

Usage:
  erun context init [flags]

Flags:
      --alias string               Cloud provider alias to use
      --context string             Kubernetes context name to create
      --disk-size int              Root disk size in GB (default 100)
      --disk-type string           Root disk type (default "gp3")
      --dry-run                    Resolve and trace mutating actions without executing them.
  -h, --help                       help for init
      --instance-type string       EC2 instance type (default "c8gd.2xlarge")
      --key-name string            Optional EC2 key pair name
      --region string              Cloud region for the context (default "eu-west-2")
      --security-group-id string   Optional EC2 security group ID
      --subnet-id string           Optional EC2 subnet ID

Global Flags:
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.
